segments.name: direct medical procedure services
segments.description: Provides patented minimally invasive AirSculpt body contouring, fat removal, fat transfer and skin tightening procedures to patients at centers across the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating and one reportable segment: direct medical procedure services.

revenueModel.text: Patients pay the Company for body contouring procedures performed at its centers.
revenueModel.evidence: We performed 11,852 body contouring procedures in 2025.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company closed and deconsolidated its London, United Kingdom facility.
changes.evidence: On September 1, 2025, the Company made the decision to close our facility in the United Kingdom because of its financial performance, which was deemed a triggering event for long-lived asset impairment testing.
